item.title: Notify NYC - Columbus Day Parade - 10/12 (MN)
item.description:
Notification issued 10-11-2026 at 03:00 PM.
As part of the Columbus Day Parade, 5th Avenue between East 42nd Street and East 79th Street in Manhattan will be closed tomorrow, 10/12, at the discretion of the NYPD. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time. Additional road closures in the surrounding area are possible.
For more information, please visit: on.nyc.gov/traffic
